baseline_bump_justification: 2026-05-30 Phase-11 precision-guard: web baseline raised 11343 -> 11662 (+319 net) by introducing two WARN-level rules (precision/no-hardcoded-step, precision/no-parsefloat-on-money). The rules surface pre-existing float-precision debt (hardcoded fractional step= literals on number inputs; parseFloat()/Number() coercion of money/quantity-named values). 29 step + 291 parseFloat hits. The Phase-10-migrated MoneyInput/QuantityInput atoms and forms carry ZERO new-rule violations on their money/quantity inputs; the surfaced hits are legacy/unmigrated callsites (percentage-field step literals and computation-side parseFloat) outside the Phase-10 input-migration scope.
